meta.name: multiplayer
meta.description: Multiplayer game development principles. Architecture, networking, synchronization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 掌握多人游戏架构与网络同步的核心原理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多人游戏,需要理清同步与网络方案
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a multiplayer game and need to clarify sync and networking approaches.

howto.what: Claude会按这套多人游戏开发原则提供建议:帮你选服务器架构(如专用服务器、主机托管)、说明同步方式(状态同步/输入同步)、减少网络流量的技巧、防作弊要点等。产出的是技术选型建议和注意事项。
howto.when: 当你请Claude设计或解决多人游戏问题,如讨论联机对战、网络同步、服务器架构或匹配机制时触发。

say.text: 我想做实时对战游戏,该选什么服务器架构?
say.note: Claude会按类型给出架构建议

say.text: 玩家操作不同步,怎么解决?
say.note: Claude会讲同步和延迟补偿技术

say.text: 如何防止玩家刷物品和加速?
say.note: Claude会讲服务器权威和反作弊

howto.what_en: Claude provides multiplayer development guidelines: architecture choices, sync methods, bandwidth reduction, security principles, matchmaking factors, and anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to design or troubleshoot a multiplayer game, e.g., choosing architecture, sync, optimization, or anti-cheat.

say_en.text: I'm making a real-time PvP game. What server architecture should I use?
say_en.note: Claude suggests according to game type.

say_en.text: Player actions are out of sync. How do I fix it?
say_en.note: Covers state/input sync and lag comp.

say_en.text: How do I stop item duping and speed hacks?
